briefing: Markets were neutral today (NASDAQ -0.1%, S&P 500 +0.4%) with no clear risk-on signal. Cash on hand ($289.29) is below the $500 deployment threshold, so per past lessons we're holding rather than forcing a buy — waiting for a genuine risk-on setup with multi-signal confirmation.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: "Dry powder" refers to cash kept on the sidelines, ready to deploy when a strong opportunity appears. Today, with only $289 in cash and no strong risk-on signal, the disciplined move is to hold that cash rather than force a mediocre trade — patience preserves capital for better setups.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「乾火藥」（Dry Powder）是指預留在場邊、等待時機出手的現金。今日現金僅有289美元，且市場未見明顯的風險偏好信號，因此審慎的做法是持有現金而非勉強交易——耐心等待能為未來更好的機會保留資本。

market_education.summary_en: Today was a mixed, low-conviction session: the S&P 500 edged up 0.4% while the NASDAQ slipped -0.1%, suggesting rotation out of high-growth tech names into broader-market holdings rather than a decisive directional move. Without a clear catalyst, trading stayed range-bound across major indices. This kind of quiet divergence often precedes a bigger move once new economic data or earnings news arrives.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日市場走勢分歧、信號不強：標普500指數上升0.4%，納斯達克則微跌0.1%，反映資金可能從高增長科技股輪動至較廣泛的大盤股，而非出現明確的方向性走勢。在缺乏明顯催化因素下，主要指數維持區間震盪。此類溫和分歧走勢，往往預示著在新的經濟數據或財報公布後,市場可能出現更大幅度的波動。
